stages.discovery: A crooked hut squats on stilts above the mire, herbs and small animal skulls strung from the eaves. Smoke the color of a bruise curls from a chimney that shouldn't still be standing, and something inside is humming a tune with no tune to it.

choices.label: Ask for a Ward Against Rot
choices.outcome: A withered hand parts the curtain just enough to take your coin and press a blackened silver dagger into your palm. "Wear it, or carry it," she rasps, "and the damp won't take you as easy." The door shuts before you can ask what she means.

choices.label: Leave an Offering, Ask Nothing
choices.description: Set something on the step and walk on
choices.outcome: You leave a scrap of food on the doorstep and back away without knocking. Behind you, the humming stops - just for a moment, as if something noticed.

choices.label: Give the Hut a Wide Berth
choices.description: ESC also cancels - some doors aren't worth knocking on
choices.outcome: You keep to the far side of the trail and let the hut and its smoke fall behind you.
